recommendations.title: Free the web service port held by the old process
recommendations.action: Confirm the process on port 8008 is an old Core process, end it, then start the Core service and watch the log.
recommendations.rationale: Log says the web service port is already in use and the customer found an old Core worker process on it, which fits the service stopping seconds after start.

KB: Core service stops after upgrade, port already in use

recommendations.title: Compare the upgrade steps with what was done last night
recommendations.action: Check the upgrade guide for stopping services before install and look for a failed stop in the installer log.
recommendations.rationale: The installer reported success, but an old process survived the upgrade; the installer log should show whether the old service was stopped cleanly.

recommendations.title: Known issue: old worker process left running after upgrade
recommendations.action: Check whether the open ticket on a leftover process after upgrade applies to Core 5.13.2.
recommendations.rationale: A similar service-start failure is on file; it would confirm the workaround and whether a fix is planned.

sources.label: Core: old worker process left running after upgrade blocks service start

recommendations.title: Fallback: move the web service to a free port
recommendations.action: If the port stays taken after the old process is gone, move the Core web service to a free port.
recommendations.rationale: Only needed if the conflict persists; changing the port also means updating any client that uses the old one.
